title: Elemental Workshop II
start: Search the bookshelf in the Exam Centre in the Varrock Dig Site for an old book.

items.t: 8 coal (12 if you wish to also make a mind shield)
Battered key (May be in steel key ring; can be obtained during quest)

recommended.t: Activated Seers' Village lodestone, runes for Camelot Teleport, or a Camelot teleport tablet
The Archaeology journal, Master archaeologist's outfit, or Dig Site pendant for quick access to the Exam Centre

rewards.t: Ability to make elemental helmets, mind shields, and mind helmets

steps.t: Go to the Exam Centre in the south of the Archaeology Campus and search the bookshelf on the eastern wall in the Exam Centre. [Chat: Accept]

sub.t: Use Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Campus just north of the Exam Centre.
If you end up with Varmen's notes, you searched the wrong bookshelf.

steps.t: Read the scroll inside the beaten book and keep the book.
Head to the building with an anvil west of the Seers' Village bank.
Click on the odd-looking wall to enter it.

sub.t: If it says "You see a small hole in the wall but no way to open it", go to the building directly south and search the bookcase on the east wall for a battered key.

steps.t: Go down the stairs.
Go north to the water elemental room and search the machinery in the southwest of the room to get a key.
Obtain 2 elemental ores from the west room by attempting to mine the elemental rocks, and defeating the earth elementals that spawn.
Go back to the north room (where you got the key) and pull the lever to start the water wheel (if the wheel is already turning, this step can be skipped).
Go to the east room and pull the lever to start the bellows (if the bellows are already working, this step can be skipped).
Smelt two elemental bars in the south room. ('Use' the ore on the furnace.)
Open the hatch in the middle room, and climb down it.
Take from the schematic crate south of the stairs and take both options.
Go back up the spiral stairs and smith a crane claw on the workbench using an elemental bar.
Go back down and lower the Old crane using the lever directly next to the schematic crate.
Use the claw on the crane to repair it.
Place an elemental bar on the jig cart.
Pull the west lever by the schematic crate.
Pull the east lever.
Pull the west lever twice.
Pull the east lever.
Pull the west lever twice.
Pull the lever behind you, by the mine cart sign.

sub.t: If the lever is pulled and it says the system is not pressurised, go upstairs and activate the water wheel and bellows.

steps.t: Climb the staircase in the south-west corner.
Move to the west side by the steam press.
Open the junction box and connect the pipes by clicking on a pair of pipe holes. Refer to the solution on the right.
Go downstairs and pull the lever next to the three small pipes.

sub.t: If successful, you will get a message that the bar has been flattened.

steps.t: Pull the lever by the mine cart sign.
Search all of the crates in both the area with the track and the upper level with the junction box to find 3 cogs and a pipe.
Go back up the northeast platform stairs.
Go north of the water tank and 'use' the pipe item on the piping with a hole in it.
Go back down to the water tank and pull the 'old lever' in front of the tank's door to open it.
Turn the corkscrew lever (to the east) twice to load the elemental sheet into the water tank.
Pull the old lever to close the door.
Turn the water valve west of the old lever to open the valve.
Turn the water valve east of the old lever to raise the water level.
Wait for the water to fill the tank, then turn the east valve again, to lower the water level back down.
Turn the water valve west of the old lever to close off the water valve.
Pull the old lever to open the door.
Turn the corkscrew twice.
Pull the old lever to close the door.
Pull the lever by the mine cart sign.
Go over to the machine on the east side.
On the side of the machine are three pins, place the cogs on the correct pins.

sub.t: The small cog goes on the upper left pin, the medium cog on the lower left pin, and the large cog on the right pin.

steps.t: Pull the lever just to the south to start the fan.

sub.t: If the message says the fan is sucking, the cogs are not on the correct pins. Turn the fan off and position the cogs correctly.
If the machine says "It must be powered somewhere else", head upstairs and make sure the water wheel to the north is rotating. If not, pull the lever near the wheel.

steps.t: Pull the lever again.
Pull the lever by the mine cart sign.
Go by the claw and pick up the primed bar.
Go down another level in the workshop (north west stairwell).
Enter the east door (mind door).
Place the bar on the extractor gun. If you miss this step, you will take 10% damage by doing the next step.
Operate the extractor hat.
Take the mind bar from the extractor gun.
Go back up to the top floor of the workshop.
On the workbench, smith a mind helmet, with the beaten book in the backpack.

sub.t: If you have an elemental bar in your inventory you will need to switch to the Mind Equipment section.

steps.t: Quest complete!
